items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: a lot of us that never really played with him, we recorded with his band around, Dexter Gordon, myself, a bunch of us did.

ctx.x: And, of course, John Hammond used to have a lot of dates around there then because he used to use Buck Clayton on quite a few. He used Buck as the leader on quite a few things, and I played a few of those things with Buck, and they would really swing, you know, some of these things.

But almost every day you'd be recording with somebody. I know Eckstein came in town. He wanted to record, and he used a big band, with Eckstein -- a lot of us that never really played with him, we recorded with his band around, Dexter Gordon, myself, a bunch of us did.
But this is during the same period of time that we all worked 52nd Street. Musicians were available because they were right in town working, you know, was very easy to get them together.
